notes: And when answers to two written morphemes here, the waw and ki, so rule 55's fused pair does not arise.

The two mippene-type prepositions are read differently because the ASV writes different English: because of is one compound on min, and by reason of is the fusion of min with pene, each headed on its content word (rule 24).
The anticipatory it of it repented Jehovah belongs to the recast finite verb (rule 44), and the dative lahem is unrepresented beside its object suffix them (rule 40).
